findings.finding: The sealed tar was stale relative to reviewed source.
findings.remediation: The rejected tar is preserved only under an unmistakable .REJECTED.d4c91a5e name. Final package and tar are rebuilt from the current checked source, and a new critic verdict must bind the new tar SHA256.

findings.finding: Rollback assertions could be ignored because rollback_previous ran as a Bash if condition.
findings.remediation: Every mutation and validation in old_identity and rollback_previous has an explicit || return 1 failure edge; the failure marker reports rollback_restored only after the entire proof succeeds.

Exact successor ALREADY_INSTALLED reconciliation, exact or repairable root store reconciliation, partial successor rollback, and a root-owned bootstrap guard make reruns deterministic after interruption.

findings.finding: Required manifests and procedures were outside the sealed artifact.
findings.remediation: The payload contains and integrity-checks review/human-manifest.md, review/package-manifest.json, review/installation-procedure.md and review/rollback-analysis.md.

findings.finding: Anonymous Docker migration runners could survive client timeout.
findings.remediation: Preview, rollback-proof, production-migration and backup-list runners have fixed names plus exact profile/runner labels and collision-safe inspect, kill and remove cleanup.

findings.finding: Production migration interruption recovery was absent.
findings.remediation: DATABASE_PRODUCTION_INTENT is durably persisted before production mutation; retries reconcile exact pending/applied states and fixed-runner cleanup before continuing.

findings.finding: Production DATABASE_URL was not bound to the inspected database.
findings.remediation: The URL must use the fixed postgres host and port and its decoded username and database path must exactly equal the inspected POSTGRES_USER and POSTGRES_DB; query and fragment are forbidden.

findings.finding: A stale backup could be reused across attempts.
findings.remediation: A prior exact root-only backup is removed and a new O_EXCL custom dump is created on every fresh migration attempt; its SHA256, byte count and restore proof are persisted in the production intent state.

findings.finding: Outbox schema EXACT did not prove the complete definition.
findings.remediation: Catalog comparison now pins enum order, all columns in ordinal order, types, nullability, defaults, primary-key constraint and complete normalized index definitions.

RELEASE_ACTIVATION_INTENT is persisted before Compose mutation. Retry reconciles old or target identity, proves full target health, and automatically restores the pinned predecessor if a recovered target fails postcheck. Explicit rollback accepts the intent phase.

findings.finding: Activation postcheck did not pin the safety-critical process contract.
findings.remediation: Both fresh and ALREADY_ACTIVATED postchecks require exact image, npm run start command, app user, /app workdir, tini entrypoint, health, schema and unrelated-container identities.

findings.finding: Concurrent service-restart could fork audit mutation state.
findings.remediation: The successor policy removes service-restart from every container resource while preserving sudoers bytes, so only profile-lock-serialized activation mutations remain available.
